issues.name: OpenAPI spec published
issues.recommendation: Publish an OpenAPI (Swagger) specification at /openapi.json or /api/openapi.yaml. This is how agents understand your API surface automatically.

issues.details: vox.isolated.tech was not in the top 10 for "Vox.md note capture"
issues.name: Brand name discoverability
issues.recommendation: Make sure your own domain ranks in the top results when people search your brand together with your main product (for example "Acme payments API"). If it does not, your brand may be too generic, conflict with a more established term, or not yet indexed. Strengthen it by describing your main product clearly in your homepage title and headings, earning press mentions that link to your domain, and avoiding redirect chains that mask your main domain in search results.

issues.name: CLI tool available
issues.recommendation: Publish an official CLI tool on npm, PyPI, or Homebrew. A CLI lets agents and developers script interactions with your product without building API integrations from scratch.

issues.name: API schema complexity analysis
issues.recommendation: Make your API spec self-describing: a unique operationId and a description on every operation, typed parameters, and response schemas. For GraphQL, a fully typed schema with a documented cost or rate limit reads best.

issues.details: No API spec found - function calling requires discoverable endpoints
issues.name: Function calling compatibility
issues.recommendation: Ensure API endpoints have unique operation IDs, typed schemas, and descriptions compatible with LLM function-calling formats.

issues.details: Name search surfaced no pages on vox.isolated.tech, although developer resources exist on the site (API docs) - weak search indexing or transient search noise
issues.name: Developer resource discoverability
issues.recommendation: Check whether your developer resources (API docs, OpenAPI spec, auth docs, developer portal, MCP server, SDK documentation) surface in name-based searches. If they do not, use predictable URLs, link them in llms.txt, and include your product name in page titles and headings. This result reflects one search sample.

issues.details: Organization schema found but missing: address
issues.name: Organization schema completeness
issues.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD that includes both contactPoint (with email/phone and contactType) and address (PostalAddress). This lets AI verify your business legitimacy and answer contact queries.
